items.name: Upwork
items.title: Open bidding marketplace
items.excerpt: $15-110/hr. Best starting point with zero track record. Commission drops sharply on repeat clients, so build long-term relationships fast.

items.name: Fiverr
items.title: Gig-based marketplace
items.excerpt: $10-100+ (per-gig pricing)/hr. Good for productized services (e.g. 'I will build a WordPress site'). Flat 20% never drops regardless of volume, unlike Upwork.

items.name: Freelancer.com
items.title: Bidding + contest marketplace
items.excerpt: $10-80/hr. Contest feature is a genuine way to get discovered without prior reviews. Lower average project quality than Upwork.

items.name: Toptal
items.title: Elite vetted marketplace
items.excerpt: $80-200+/hr. Highest ceiling on this list. Long, unpaid time investment to get in - budget several weeks for the process before expecting income.
items.who: Bank transfer / wire (confirm Payoneer support at application)

items.name: Gun.io
items.title: Elite vetted marketplace
items.excerpt: $70-150+/hr. Skips Toptal's deposit but is equally selective. Historically skews toward US/Canada-based talent, so African applicants should confirm current geographic openness before investing time.

items.name: Turing
items.title: AI-matched vetted marketplace
items.excerpt: $30-100+ (dedicated contract rates)/hr. Structured like a job placement, not freelance bidding. Explicitly recruits from Africa - one of the more realistic elite options for Nigerians.
items.who: Direct deposit / bank transfer - explicitly recruits African talent

items.name: Andela
items.title: Dedicated staffing / talent network
items.excerpt: $60-100+ (contract)/hr. 25% of annual salary for permanent placement; no upfront cost to search

items.name: Arc.dev (formerly Codementor)
items.title: Vetted marketplace + full-time placement
items.excerpt: $60-150/hr. Can convert freelance engagements to full-time. Low acceptance rate but transparent about what happens to the client's money.

items.name: Lemon.io
items.title: Vetted startup-focused marketplace
items.excerpt: $50-95/hr. Less competition than Toptal once accepted, and matches happen fast. Client base skews toward startups rather than enterprises.

items.name: Contra
items.title: Direct-hire marketplace
items.excerpt: Self-set (market rate). Best fee structure on this list for hourly work. Discovery-based, so it works best alongside a platform with active gig-hunting like Upwork, not alone.

items.name: Braintrust
items.title: Token-governed talent network
items.excerpt: $45-150+ (freelancer keeps 100% of negotiated rate)/hr. Freelancer keeps full rate, which is rare. Token/governance model is unusual - some reviewers are skeptical of the '0% fee' framing since client rates may already p

items.name: Codeable
items.title: WordPress-specialist marketplace
items.excerpt: $60-120 (WordPress-specific)/hr. Apply > submit WordPress code samples > pass technical review > accepted into exclusive WordPress-only pool

items.name: PeoplePerHour
items.title: UK-centered bidding marketplace
items.excerpt: $15-80/hr. Skews toward UK clients specifically - useful if you're targeting that market, less relevant otherwise.

items.name: Codementor
items.title: Instant-help marketplace
items.excerpt: PayPal / bank transfer. Create mentor profile > set your own hourly session rate > get booked for live coding help/debugging sessions

items.name: Crossover
items.title: Full-time remote placement (not freelance)
items.excerpt: $100,000-$400,000/year for top talent (salaried, not hourly). Not gig work - this is full-time employment with a global company. Highest total compensation on this list but the most competitive and least flexible.

items.name: We Work Remotely
items.title: Remote job board (listings only)
items.excerpt: Varies by listed role. One of the oldest, most trusted remote job boards. Not a marketplace - you're applying for real jobs, so treat listings like normal job applications.

items.name: RemoteOK
items.title: Remote job board (listings only)
items.excerpt: Varies by listed role. Filtering by 'Worldwide' is essential - many listings are US/EU-only despite being remote. Free and high-volume.

items.name: FlexJobs
items.title: Curated remote/flexible job aggregator
items.excerpt: Varies by listed role. Paid, but the screening genuinely cuts down on fake postings - worth it if you've been burned by scam job boards before.

items.name: Wellfound (formerly AngelList Talent)
items.title: Startup-focused job board
items.excerpt: Varies (salary + equity shown upfront). Startups here are often more open to international/remote hires than large enterprises, but expect equity-heavy compensation and higher risk.

items.name: Remotive
items.title: Curated tech-focused remote job board
items.excerpt: Varies by listed role. Smaller and more curated than RemoteOK - fewer listings but higher average relevance for developers specifically.
